result.question_1_answer_summary: Genuine effort to construct a gate-defeating counterexample found no case where the gate's WORDING has already caused a wrong rejection of a technique that would in fact have cheaply and correctly solved the problem (all thirteen rounds' actual rejections rest on substantive Theta(B^3) cost or genuine witness dependence). It DID find two disclosed wording-level miscalibration risks and one textual ambiguity that could cause a wrong rejection on a future, differently-shaped candidate: G2 excludes named artifact TYPES (support tables, source enumeration) rather than the budget/information-content test its own frozen verifier (V1-V3/V6) already performs precisely, and does not disambiguate g_I's own free public roots from r_R's ECDLP-equivalent ones; G8 excludes by route-FAMILY identity rather than by cost-exponent delta, a gap round twelve's own practice already had to informally paper over. Exact corrected wording for both items is proposed in gate-calibration-analysis.yaml, with no retroactive change to any of the thirteen rounds' verdicts.
result.question_2_answer_summary: One structural argument (a coefficient-space-versus-ideal/root-space dichotomy) was constructed and subjected to docs/inventor-protocol.md Section 8's four audits. It passes baseline reproduction (exact, frozen-fixture-verified against EXP-CREP-001's execution-report.yaml) and is correctly statable under an existential-negative-over-a-finite-list quantifier order, but it FAILS the observation-collision audit and, consequently, the proves-too-much control: applied in its general form to subproduct-tree/remainder-tree reduction of a product of known linear factors (a real, public, witness-free, quasi-linear technique), the argument incorrectly predicts impossibility there too. The accumulated evidence therefore does NOT support the requested structural claim in the strong form the dispatch handoff named; the surviving residual is the already-recorded EMPIRICAL fact that EXP-CREP-001's own remainder-tree-style routes (ROUTE-04, ROUTE-07) also measured Theta(B^3) for the P1553 object specifically, whose EXPLANATION requires an internal algebraic derivation task no round to date has performed. H-CREP-001's framing is recommended to be revisited and narrowed in future round LANGUAGE (avoid implying inductive strengthening toward a proof) but its status and EXP-CREP-001's specification are left unchanged; this task has no authority to change either and finds no basis to recommend a status change.
result.summary: A bounded, zero-experiment, zero-network, non-batch analytical review of the frozen pre-admission gate's G2/G8 wording and of whether the accumulated thirteen-round-plus-EXP-CREP-001 evidence base supports a scoped structural argument. No B71, experiment, implementation, scientific transition, attack, speedup, novelty, closure, support, completion, or breakthrough claim is made. No hypothesis status or experiment specification is changed. Two considered findings are recorded: a gate-wording calibration finding (two risks, one ambiguity, with proposed corrected wording) and a framing-revisit finding (a structural argument attempted, found not to survive its own proves-too-much control, with a named missing derivation that would be required to do better).
